verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a SaaS compliance platform, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions data residency, region selection, or hosting location. The GDPR framework pages describe helping customers achieve their own compliance, and the IP allowlist articles cover network access; neither is a residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
